data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure step for step (Careers, Openings, the country, team and time type filters, search, open a job and apply) and names country, team and time type as parameters; it loses a point on feasibility because it lacks an explicit action parameter (open vs. save) and names "job title" as a parameter when the job is chosen by link.
